title: This Open Source Tool Turns AI Against Companies Using AI to Filter You Out
description:
CareerOps runs inside Claude Code, Codex, or whatever AI CLI you already use. Paste a job link and it scores it one to five, flags scam listings, builds a tailored ATS resume, and even finds the hiring manager to DM. The builder ran it on 740 jobs and landed an applied AI role. Your resume just got its own recruiter.

#career #aitools #ai #github #claude #codex
